subject.name: History
subject.textbook: CUP Option B: the 20th Century 3rd ed.
subject.examPattern: Paper 1 Structured 2 h, 60 marks (40%): answer 2 of 8 core questions + 1 depth-study question, each in parts (a)(b)(c). Paper 2 Document questions 1 h 45, 40 marks (30%): 1 question, 5 parts, up to 7 sources. Component 3 Coursework (2,000 words) or Paper 4 Alternative 1 h, 40 marks (30%). Model writes all 18 P1 questions + P2 + P4.

items.name: Depth Study A: The First World War, 1914-18
Depth Study E: The Second World War, 1939-c.1945

subtopics.name: Why the war was not over by December 1914: the Schlieffen Plan, Mons, the Marne and the race to the sea
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Empires and alliances before 1914 (IGCSE yr 1 background chapter)

subtopics.name: Why there was stalemate on the Western Front: trench warfare, Verdun and the Somme
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Failure of the Schlieffen Plan; defensive technology (machine guns, artillery)

subtopics.name: How important were other fronts? Gallipoli, the war at sea and the Eastern Front
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Stalemate on the Western Front; map of Europe and the Ottoman Empire

subtopics.name: Why Germany asked for an armistice in 1918: blockade, US entry and the Ludendorff Offensive
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Other fronts and the war at sea; home front pressures in Germany

subtopics.name: Was the Weimar Republic doomed from the start? Constitution, Versailles and the crises of 1919-23
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Treaty of Versailles and its impact on Germany to 1923 (IGCSE yr 1)

subtopics.name: Recovery under Stresemann, 1924-29
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Crises of 1923 (hyperinflation, Ruhr); Dawes Plan and Locarno

subtopics.name: Why Hitler was able to dominate Germany by 1934: Depression, elections and the consolidation of power
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Stresemann era; impact of the Depression (IGCSE yr 1 League chapter)

subtopics.name: How effectively the Nazis controlled Germany, 1933-45: terror, propaganda and opposition
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Hitler's rise to power; Enabling Act and Night of the Long Knives

subtopics.name: What was it like to live in Nazi Germany? Women, youth, workers and the persecution of minorities
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Nazi control methods; Nazi ideology and racial policy

subtopics.name: Why the tsarist regime collapsed in 1917: the 1905 Revolution, Nicholas II and the First World War
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Eastern Front in the First World War; autocracy and social structure of Russia

subtopics.name: How the Bolsheviks gained power in October 1917: the Provisional Government and Lenin
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Collapse of tsarism; dual power and the April Theses

subtopics.name: How the Bolsheviks consolidated their rule: Civil War, War Communism and the NEP
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: October Revolution; Red and White forces

subtopics.name: How Stalin gained and held on to power: the leadership struggle and the purges
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Lenin's death and the NEP debate; Trotsky versus Stalin

subtopics.name: The impact of Stalin's economic policies: collectivisation and the Five-Year Plans
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Stalin's power; NEP and the need to industrialise

subtopics.name: How far the US economy boomed in the 1920s: mass production, credit and the groups left out
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: USA's refusal to join the League and isolationism (IGCSE yr 1)

subtopics.name: How far US society changed in the 1920s: Prohibition, intolerance, immigration and the Roaring Twenties
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Economic boom; Red Scare and Ku Klux Klan background

subtopics.name: The causes and consequences of the Wall Street Crash
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Weaknesses of the 1920s economy; buying shares on the margin

subtopics.name: How successful was the New Deal? Roosevelt's alphabet agencies and opposition
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Wall Street Crash and the Depression; Hoover's response

subtopics.name: German successes, 1939-41: Blitzkrieg, Dunkirk and the Battle of Britain
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Outbreak of war in September 1939 (IGCSE yr 1)

subtopics.name: The war on the Eastern Front: Operation Barbarossa to Stalingrad and Kursk
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: German successes; Stalin's industrialisation (Depth Study C)

subtopics.name: The war in the Pacific: Pearl Harbor, Midway and the atomic bombs
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: German successes; US isolationism and the New Deal (Depth Study D)

subtopics.name: Allied victory in Europe: D-Day, strategic bombing and the Holocaust
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Eastern Front; Nazi racial policy (Depth Study B)

subtopics.name: Coursework and Paper 4 skills: framing a question, using sources and interpretations, writing an extended answer
subtopics.prerequisiteNote: Analysing sources and reaching a judgement (IGCSE yr 1 skills chapter)
